sentence: This project provides imaging services, such as optical coherence tomography and confocal microscopy, to researchers who study the visual system.
This project studies how Medicaid expansion and automatic enrollment affect coverage, healthcare access, and mortality among people with disabilities.
This project studies how a circadian gene affects memory and circadian rhythmicity in aging.
This project studies how transcription factors recognize DNA binding sites and recruit co-regulators to control their target genes during animal development.
This project studies how genetic ancestry contributes to cancer outcomes in a large publicly available registry of cancer patients.
This project uses a high-throughput screening method to find chromatin factors involved in DNA repair in mammalian cells.
This project tests how genetics and high intensity aerobic exercise together affect the progression of Parkinson's disease.
This project shares software tools with researchers who study limited mobility from conditions such as osteoarthritis and limb loss.
This project studies the causes and consequences of adenosine signaling and immunosuppression in pancreatic cancer.
This project provides microscopy and imaging equipment and support to researchers who study cells and tissues of the visual system.
This project combines genetic data from a large biobank with brain molecular profiling data to study variants linked to serious mental illness.
This project builds a technology platform that resolves structural transformations and flexibility of functional nucleic acids.
This project studies how a mitochondrial channel affects liver metabolic pathways in obesity and nonalcoholic fatty liver disease.
This project studies how glycine receptors, a family of proteins, relieve chronic pain and inhibit reward circuits in the brain.
This project studies how binge alcohol intake triggers inflammation and atrial fibrillation, and what role a stress-response kinase plays.
This project develops nanoimaging technologies to study the origin of cancer stem cells and how they adapt to chemotherapies.
This project tests how somatic mutations in DNA relate to Alzheimer's disease progression and to the buildup of misfolded proteins in the brain.
This project engineers sheets of stem cells from urine to release a factor that repairs the cornea after mustard gas injury.
This project studies how hypoxia controls T cell infiltration and function in pancreatic cancer.
This project provides MRI scans and secure data handling to study brain and spine structure and function.
